scope: 48 individually authored guides: 8 existing Scottish cities and 6 existing service intents. No generated copy or unregistered combinations.
method: Official council, university, government and heritage sources establish local facts. Moving recommendations are original conditional planning advice, not reports of completed jobs or site inspections. No source proves demand or actual property access.
retrievalLimitations: Some council pages returned 403 or a JavaScript shell; only the stated facts visible in official indexed extracts are used.
The Perth draft conservation appraisal was not used: direct retrieval failed because the PDF was too large.
No current loading hours, parking fees, named road closures, driving times, local driver availability, residence partnerships, job counts or reviews have been invented.
Historic built-form sources describe local context only; they do not establish the present access of an individual property.
